messages.language.label: Caregiver's language
messages.language.help: Choose the language the caregiver is speaking. The app does not detect it automatically.
messages.i18n.draftNotice: Screen text in {language} is an unreviewed draft translation.
messages.visit.title: New Visit
messages.capture.howTitle: How do you want to record the problem?
messages.capture.placeholder: What is wrong, in the caregiver's own words.
messages.capture.translationNotInstalled: Automatic translation of typed {language} is not available on this system. Type the English meaning yourself, record voice instead, or use the checklist.
messages.capture.translationUnavailable: Translation is not reachable right now. Type the English meaning yourself, or use the checklist.
messages.capture.offlineNotice: You are offline. Automatic analysis needs internet — use the symptom checklist now. It uses the same danger-sign rules.
messages.review.title: Check before analysis
messages.review.originalHint: Correct anything that was misheard or mistyped.
messages.review.statusManual: English typed or corrected by you.
messages.review.statusMissing: No English yet. Translate, or type the English meaning.
messages.review.statusStale: You changed the original. This English may no longer match. Translate again or correct the English.
messages.review.blocked.english_required: Enter the English meaning before continuing.
messages.review.blocked.translation_stale: Update the English so it matches the corrected original.
messages.review.transcriptSuspect: The automatic check found the original-language text unreliable (repeated or unusual output). Compare it with what the caregiver said and correct it, or record again.
messages.review.translationSuspect: The automatic check found this English translation unreliable. Check it carefully and correct it before confirming.
messages.review.firstCaptured: The first captured text is kept in the record even if you correct it.
messages.voice.consent: The caregiver agreed to this voice recording.
messages.voice.consentFirst: Ask the caregiver for permission and tick the box before recording.
messages.voice.transcribing: Transcribing… this can take up to a minute.
messages.voice.privacy: Audio is used only to produce the text below. It is not stored on the server.
messages.voice.error.permission_denied: Microphone permission was denied. Allow the microphone in the browser settings, or type the complaint.
messages.voice.error.no_microphone: No microphone was found. Type the complaint instead.
messages.voice.error.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Type the complaint instead.
messages.voice.error.insecure_context: Recording needs a secure (https) connection. Type the complaint instead.
messages.voice.error.recorder_failed: Recording failed. Try again, or type the complaint.
messages.voice.error.too_short: The recording was too short. Record again.
messages.voice.error.too_long: The recording is longer than {max} seconds. Record a shorter message.
messages.voice.error.too_large: The recording is too large. Record a shorter message.
messages.voice.error.unsupported_format: This recording format is not supported. Type the complaint instead.
messages.voice.error.invalid_audio: The recording could not be read. Record again.
messages.voice.error.transcription_empty: No speech was recognised. Record again closer to the caregiver.
messages.voice.error.transcription_unavailable: Voice transcription is not available right now. Type the complaint or use the checklist.
messages.voice.error.invalid_request: The recording could not be sent. Record again.
messages.voice.queuedOffline: Saved on this phone for patient {abha}. It will be transcribed when you are back online, and you will need to confirm it. If the child may be seriously ill, use the checklist now.
messages.voice.queuedUnavailable: Transcription is not reachable. The recording is saved on this phone and will be retried. Use typed input or the checklist now if needed.
messages.analyze.unavailable: Automatic analysis is not available right now. Use the symptom checklist — it uses the same rules.
messages.result.clinicalFallback: Clinical text is shown in English because a reviewed {language} translation is not available.
messages.result.sourceLlm: Checked using the confirmed English complaint.
messages.result.sourceChecklist: Checked using the symptom checklist (works offline).
messages.save.sent: Saved. The patient has a token and is in the queue.
messages.save.queued: Saved on this phone. It will sync and get a token when you're back online.
messages.pending.title: Recordings on this phone
messages.pending.retention: Kept on this phone (not encrypted) for up to {hours} hours; audio is deleted once transcribed.
messages.pending.reviewingBanner: Reviewing a recording for patient {abha}, made {time}. Check this is the right patient before confirming.
messages.pending.notFound: This recording is no longer on this phone (deleted or expired).
